title: Utility Walkthrough on Vacant In-Place Home Resale Homes
content:
**Property services decision table — utility walkthrough.** Where an In-Place Home Resale package charges for the vacant-home check, the month's check carries a utility walkthrough addition, added together with the package's monthly vacant-home check fee into the check subtotal. The utility walkthrough addition follows the seller's active Utility Pass-Through Service account on the site and the file's winterization charges:

- an active account on a schedule that supplies natural gas or propane, for a home with a winterization charge on the file fewer than 5 whole calendar months old, adds 25.00;
- an active account on a natural gas or propane schedule, for a home without such a charge, adds 20.00;
- an active account on any other schedule adds 10.00;
- a site with no active utility account adds nothing.

**Schedules that supply natural gas or propane:** the Submetered Water, Sewer & Natural Gas Schedule and the Submetered Water, Sewer & Propane Schedule. Every other Utility Pass-Through Service schedule is an "other schedule" here.

**Winterization charge on the file:** a winterization fee charged on this resale file's ledger whose charge date lies fewer than 5 whole calendar months before the day the check charge is worked out.

| Utility Pass-Through Service account on the site | Winterization charge fewer than 5 whole months old | Addition |
|---|---|---|
| active, natural gas or propane schedule | yes | 25.00 |
| active, natural gas or propane schedule | no | 20.00 |
| active, any other schedule | either | 10.00 |
| none active | either | 0.00 |

## Counting the winterization charge (check worked out on 10 March, hypothetical)

| Winterization charged on | Whole months to 10 March | Within the 5 months |
|---|---|---|
| 11 October of the year before | 4 | yes |
| 10 October of the year before | 5 | no |
| 2 December of the year before | 3 | yes |
